definitions.ambulance_speed_kmh: Recorded simulator speed; null when the ambulance is not present.
definitions.observed_path_distance_m: Cumulative Euclidean distance between successive recorded SUMO XY positions. Approximate between 0.5-second samples; freezes at the last recorded position before arrival. Not exact odometer distance.
definitions.ambulance_elapsed_since_dispatch_s: Elapsed time from desired dispatch, frozen at the recorded 323.5-second arrival.
definitions.pcl_request_for_target: Request for tracked PCL approach; may belong to another ambulance. Use focus_request_status to describe ambulance3 only.
definitions.ordinary_stopped_network: Ordinary vehicles physically present anywhere in the simulated network at speed below 0.1 m/s, including internal junction connectors. Excludes ambulances and not-yet-inserted source queues.
definitions.routing_only_ordinary_stopped_network: The same stopped-vehicle definition in the matched routing-only control run. Same synthetic demand and all three missions.
definitions.ordinary_stopped_difference_vs_routing_o: Signed difference in instantaneous ordinary stopped-vehicle counts. A count comparison for the shared three-mission scenario, not cumulative delay or the causal effect of ambulance3 alone.
definitions.pcl_ordinary_stopped_other_approaches: Ordinary stopped vehicles on incoming PCL edges other than ambulance approach 335061218.
definitions.comparison_scope: Matched routing-only run, including all three ambulances. These differences cannot be attributed to ambulance3 alone.
definitions.positive_extra_residence_vehicle_s: Sum over ordinary vehicles of positive differences in accumulated residence time versus routing-only control since t=300. Includes movement and source waiting, and excludes benefits to other vehicles; not stopped delay.
definitions.net_extra_residence_vehicle_s: Signed sum of ordinary-vehicle residence differences versus routing-only control since t=300.
definitions.positive_regular_link_count_difference: Sum across regular links of positive instantaneous ordinary vehicle-count differences versus routing-only control. Spatial count difference, not individual delay.
